source_snapshot.procedure: Run the exact AMDXIO all-link XGMI RX four-point command with BER=10, errcnt=5 and specified phase/DAC ranges.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect AMDXIO result files for margin analysis; no quantitative PASS/FAIL threshold is stated.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL runs AMDXIO and collects CSVs but loosely mentions PCIe/retimer files and an undefined user reference.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires complete expected XGMI topology, signed tool, exact parameters, per-link/lane EH/EW reference limits, missing-lane handling and load/error recovery.

old_problem: The source defines a coherent all-link collection method but no quantitative signal-integrity acceptance; file creation cannot establish lane quality, and DeepSeek widened the artifact scope beyond XGMI.
disposition_reason: The literal XGMI AMDXIO method is executable once the signed tool and topology are supplied. Per-link/lane EH/EW limits are a Project Configuration Requirement under ED-15/ED-23: absence prevents PASS but does not require another review-method decision. Unrelated PCIe/retimer files are excluded.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row202 all18 XLSX cells and history2807.
Preserved the exact all-link XGMI four-point parameters and complete expected topology/cardinality.
Parameterized the project SI reference while prohibiting artifact-only PASS. No AMDXIO or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized all-link XGMI RX four-point margin collection and SI evaluation
test_case.purpose: Acquire four-point XGMI RX eye-width/eye-height evidence for every expected link/lane and evaluate it against the approved platform SI reference without hiding missing or unsupported lanes.
required_package: Signed AMDXIO binary/version/schema and vendor support for the exact command
Stable GPU/package/XGMI link and lane topology manifest
Exact source parameters: all links, BER=10, errcnt=5, 4pt, phase 2:0.2 left/right, DAC 4:0.4 top/bottom
Approved per-link/lane EW/EH limits/reference and missing/unsupported-lane policy
Maintenance/load window, watchdog, error/thermal abort and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After tool, topology, threshold and safety approval, run `sudo ./amdxio -margin -xgmi -all -ber=10 -errcnt=5 -4pt -phaseleftrange=2:0.2 -phaserightrange=2:0.2 -dactoprange=4:0.4 -dacbotrange=4:0.4`, retain complete console and XGMI result files, reconcile every expected link/lane, and apply only the approved EW/EH oracle.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected XGMI link/lane is represented with valid four-point EW/EH measurements meeting the approved reference, with no missing/unexplained lane, XGMI/GPU error, thermal/power fault or platform regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires full expected topology coverage and all approved per-link/lane EW/EH limits. File generation alone or absent thresholds cannot pass.
safety_gate: AMDXIO margining requires explicit maintenance approval and verified OOB recovery.
Bind outputs to stable GPU/link/lane identity before evaluation.
Use only the exact supported XGMI parameters; do not mix PCIe or retimer artifacts.
Abort on missing topology, tool/schema mismatch, link/GPU error, thermal/power limit or timeout; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Complete raw console and XGMI CSV/result files
Approved EW/EH reference comparison plus XGMI/GPU/thermal/kernel/BMC health
test_case.recovery: Stop the tracked margin process on fault, preserve partial results and topology/health evidence, verify all XGMI links and GPUs return to baseline, and use approved OOB/service recovery only if required. Do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and collection Criteria are coherent; missing quantitative project limits are parameterized and do not create a source contradiction.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; tool, topology and approved SI limits gate execution/PASS.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind signed AMDXIO, expected XGMI topology, per-lane EW/EH reference and abort/recovery policy.
pending.owner: XGMI signal-integrity, AMD platform/tool and GPU owners.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; absent SI limits prevent PASS and missing tool/topology prevent execution.

project_authority: Per-lane XGMI SI thresholds and missing-lane semantics are project/vendor inputs and cannot be inferred from step ranges.
